why: The reconstruction of the lost expected-issue ledger is accepted only if it reproduces this run's verdicts. matrix-v11 is the last matrix produced against the frozen ledger, and its published audit bundle recorded the verdicts that ledger yielded. Keeping the inputs those verdicts were computed from makes the calibration reproducible after the bundle itself is gone -- the run directory is untracked by design, and the previous one was lost to a machine rebuild.
